title: RLCD: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM CONTRASTIVE DISTILLATION FOR LM ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise human and automated (GPT-4) evaluations of model outputs generated from offensive or socially unacceptable prompts, assessing which response is more socially acceptable, ethical, and less prejudiced or harmful.

Evaluated as a sub-component of the overall 'Harmlessness' alignment task. The methodology uses prompt affixes that explicitly contrast ethical language with 'racist' responses, using human and GPT-4 evaluations to ensure models avoid generating racially biased text.
